note_en: Resolved per construct, from the wet lab primer list and the SnapGene cloning products read against the dry lab order archive. The 20 August order (parts list 0823_Order_Report_Gabriel/BoPep4_0823_parts.csv) puts 6xHis at the N terminus, nt 489-506, between the SamyQ signal peptide and the payload, with the note 'N-terminal only; never fuse His to Asn23': D-01, D-02, D-03 and D-06 are N-terminally tagged and D-04 and D-05 are untagged. But SamyQ-Bopep4-v2t1 and v2t2, cloned 19 August, are the codon-optimised truncations from the June and July design work and carry the earlier C-terminal His6 (run_sharp_opt.py build_base_cds is mature + His6 + stop, and every full_seq in order_rows.json ends CATCAT...TAA). Only Bopep4-WT, G17A and SamyQ-Bopep4-S15A, made 26 to 28 September, put the tag upstream. So the Peptide Design sentence that every construct ordered after 16 August ends in a free G-G-H-N is false as a universal claim, and the Molecular Dynamics sentence about a decision to move the tag to the C terminus has the direction backwards. Both sentences need editing; the tag positions themselves are no longer an open question for Chars or Gabriel.
note_zh: 依構築逐一釐清，證據為濕實驗的 2026 primer list 與 SnapGene 檔，對照乾實驗訂購封存。8/20 訂購（0823_Order_Report_Gabriel/BoPep4_0823_parts.csv）的 6xHis 在 N 端，nt 489-506，位於 SamyQ 訊號肽與酬載之間，附註為「只放 N 端，不可把 His 接在 Asn23」：D-01、D-02、D-03、D-06 為 N 端標籤，D-04、D-05 無標籤。但 8/19 選殖的 SamyQ-Bopep4-v2t1 與 v2t2 是六、七月設計的密碼子最佳化截短版，沿用較早的 C 端 His6（run_sharp_opt.py 的 build_base_cds 為 mature + His6 + stop，order_rows.json 每條 full_seq 都以 CATCAT...TAA 結尾）。只有 9/26 至 9/28 製作的 Bopep4-WT、G17A 與 SamyQ-Bopep4-S15A 把標籤放在前端。因此 Peptide Design 頁「8/16 之後訂的每一個構築都以自由的 G-G-H-N 結尾」這句話作為全稱敘述是錯的，Molecular Dynamics 頁「把純化標籤移到 C 端的決定」方向也寫反了。兩句都要改；標籤位置本身已不需要再問 Chars 或 Gabriel。
